title: OpenAI Is ‘Very Interested’ in Building Out ChatGPT Integrations for Wearables
summary: Devices like Rokid’s AI glasses can already access some OpenAI models, but not in a way that’s like full ChatGPT account access. And maybe, simultaneously, OpenAI pursues opening up its services to wearables like pendants and glasses, too.
